name: json_schema_check
description: Validate a JSON instance against a JSON Schema (a draft 2020-12 subset) and list every error with its instance path, schema path, keyword and message. Covers type, enum, const, properties, required, additionalProperties, patternProperties, items and prefixItems, contains, numeric bounds (exclusive too) and multipleOf, string length and pattern, array size and uniqueItems, allOf/anyOf/oneOf/not, if/then/else, local $ref into $defs, and optional format checks (date, date-time, email, uri...). Keywords it does not support are reported, never silently ignored.

schema_text.description: The schema as JSON text, instead of schema

instance.description: The JSON value to validate (any type)

instance_text.description: The instance as JSON text, instead of instance

formats.description: annotate: format failures are warnings (the 2020-12 default); assert: errors

errors.message: string is not of type number

catalog.source: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 Core and Validation specifications (json-schema.org); behaviour modelled on the Python jsonschema library, of which this is a stdlib subset
